read: The board is broadly sold on 1d structure under a mild risk-off BTC regime, with most perps at the 10.95 neutral funding floor; the largest imbalances are negative-funding shorts pressing on LIT and WLD and a stretched kPEPE bounce.

watchlist.note: LIT is -25.33% over 7d with funding at -34.39 annualised, 13.83 points over CEX, so shorts pay to hold a fall that has run to 1d rangePos -0.01; base case is squeeze fuel, but the 4h trend is still down.
watchlist.arms: a 4h close back above the 4h SMA20 with a level in the menu at least 2R away

watchlist.note: WLD is -28.88% over 7d, funding -10.22 annualised, the 1d low swept and rangePos -0.01; the last long was stopped, so we lean cautious, low-confidence.
watchlist.arms: a 4h close back above the 1d range low with funding still negative

watchlist.note: kPEPE is +9.2% over 24h and +13.26 vs BTC over 7d, 2.77 ATR over the 4h SMA20 with both 4h and 1d showing a high sweep and OI -3.54% over 4h; funding is at the neutral floor, so this is a stretched bounce rather than a paid-for crowd.
watchlist.arms: a 4h close back under the 4h range high after the sweep, with a level in the menu at least 2R away

watchlist.note: VVV is -12.66% over 24h with the 4h low swept and 4h vsSma20Atr -2.46, HL funding 10.92 points over CEX; a reclaim of the low could mean the flush is done, risk skews to continuation until then.
watchlist.arms: a 4h close back above the swept 4h low

watchlist.note: CHIP is -12.07% over 24h with HL funding 22.41 points over CEX and OI -3.55% over 4h; the premium is HL-local and unwinding, base case is more chop.
watchlist.arms: a 4h close back under the 4h SMA20 after a bounce

watchlist.note: BNB is +5.23 vs BTC over 7d with the 4h in an uptrend, but funding is 16.71 points over CEX, so the strength is partly HL-local.
watchlist.arms: a 1d close above the 1d SMA20 with funding vs CEX under 10 points

brief: Delta: 24h bounce has faded, BTC 79871 is back near the 1d range low (rangePos 0.12) and most 1d structures are down. XMR is the one tripwire hit: funding reset to 14.04 and a new low-conviction long is proposed off the 1d SMA20. ENA short cancelled, its HL-local funding premium is gone. LIT and WLD carry negative funding after 7d falls of -25.33% and -28.88%; base case is squeeze fuel only once a 4h reclaim shows. Four setups already open (ZEC, DOGE, AAVE, ENA until cancel). Wrong if BTC loses 1d.low20 and the weakness spreads to the uptrend names. Gap: hl-cycles is stale, 21.6 h.
